Select distinct molecules from document CHEMBL1126796. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then molecule_dictionary on molregno for chembl_id, and compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles using an inner join (only include rows with canonical_smiles available). Get compound_name from compound_records. Return chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
